verdict.rationale: Sprinto documents only narrow API surfaces: custom-integration push APIs with integration monitoring, Framework Health & Vendor Data APIs, and inbound webhooks for sending data into Sprinto. Most documented capabilities are framed as UI 'dashboard actions', such as access reviews, vendor risk assessments, audit partner selection and AI systems governance, and no OpenAPI or Swagger spec was found at the probed paths. Missing for 10: evidence of API coverage for core workflows (controls, policies, risks, tasks, access reviews, audits, AI systems), a published OpenAPI spec, any statement of UI/API parity, and independent or hands-on corroboration of API breadth.
